verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a keyboard-driven desktop distro, but it has some automation hooks: documented unattended installs, an official `omarchy` CLI that an AI agent can drive for customization and configuration, scriptable commands like `omarchy-snapshot create`, and the option to run inside a VM. Nothing shows it running headlessly or inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless (no-GUI) operation mode, CI integration or examples, non-interactive automation docs beyond the unattended-install mention, and any hands-on corroboration.
